summary: Choose several values: a trigger opens a listbox with check marks, and the chosen options show as removable chips. A signal-model control of T[]: bind [(value)] or a signal-forms field.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The chosen values; new choices are appended; two-way [(value)].

inputs.name: touched
inputs.description: Becomes true when focus leaves the component; two-way [(touched)].

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: The choices { value, label, disabled? } with translated labels.

inputs.name: compareWith
inputs.description: Matches a value to an option, e.g. (a, b) => a.id === b.id for recreated objects.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label (translated).

inputs.name: removeLabel
inputs.description: First word of each chip's remove-button name (translated); the option label follows it.

inputs.name: emptyText
inputs.description: Shown in the open list when there are no options (translated).

inputs.name: error
inputs.description: Error message (translated); a non-empty error marks the control invalid.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: aria-required on the listbox plus a decorative asterisk.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disables the trigger and the chip remove buttons.

inputs.name: invalid
inputs.description: Marks the control invalid without a message.

outputs.name: valueChange
outputs.description: The new chosen values on every toggle or removal (the model's change event).

outputs.name: touchedChange
outputs.description: Emits true when focus first leaves the component.

a11y: WAI-ARIA listbox with aria-multiselectable and aria-activedescendant. The trigger is a button with aria-haspopup, aria-expanded and aria-controls, named by label plus placeholder. Arrow Down/Up on the trigger opens the list; in it Arrow Down/Up, Home and End move (disabled options skipped, no wrap), Space/Enter toggle, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger (without closing an enclosing dialog), Tab closes. Each chip has a named remove button. Logical CSS mirrors the layout in RTL.
